1
Sughra Ne Jadon Chan Wal Takiya Honra Ayen.
Haye Akbar Keh Ke Ujari Ne Hath Dil Te Rakhiya Honra Ayen.
Meri Surkhi Wich Ne Hawaan Akbar Diyaan Mukniyaan Sanwaan.
Chan Ne V Atharo Sut Sut Ke Sughra Nu Dasiya Honra Ayen.

2
Akhiyaan Di Jaan Akbar Si Oh Nayi Te Deed Wi Muk Gayi.
Har Athro Sain Di Akhiyaan Choon Aye Keh Keh Wasiya Honra Ayen.
ALLAH-o-Akbar Rondi Hosi La-Ilaha Haray Pandi.
Azan Wichon Jad Akbar Nu Wichar Ne Labiya Honra Ayen.

3
Kar Sorat Yaad Akbar Di Aakhay Sughra Rondi Rondi.
Naiza V Wekh Ke Akbar Nu Ik War Te Kanbiya Honra Ayen.
 Jaun Akbar De Seene Da Phat Lazmi Roya Honra Aye.
Sughra Da Khat Jadoon Mula Ne Lashay Te Parya Honra Ayen.

from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/sughra-ne-jadon-chan-wal-takiya-honra-ayen-lyrics-2018-tajpoints-e8ee355dab5787187590.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---', 2)[2]
meta, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---', 2)[1:]
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
def blocks(s):
    return [block.splitlines() for block in re.split(r'\\n\\s*\\n', s.strip())]
def normalized(s):
    return [[line.strip().rstrip('.').casefold() for line in block] for block in blocks(s)]
assert normalized(old) == normalized(roman)
assert [len(b) for b in blocks(roman)] == [len(b) for b in blocks(body)] == [5, 5, 5]
PY"

Reconstructed all 12 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions have three matching four-verse stanzas. Updated the titles and language metadata and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman forms “haray pandi” and “wichar” as ہاڑے پاندی and وچار.
